verdict.rationale: Secureframe explicitly lists ISO 27001 as a supported framework, claiming customers can 'achieve and maintain ISO 27001 certification' (secureframe-docs-42), but there is no evidence of specifics like the current Annex A control set, a Statement of Applicability generator/artifact, or certification-audit-specific deliverables — the coverage is a generic one-line marketing claim similar to other frameworks rather than first-class, detailed support. missing for 10: explicit Annex A control mapping detail, SoA generation/artifact, ISO-specific certification audit workflow/evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
